body: I missed this in the previous PR but since `params` isn't a WebIDL type I don't think using a `Uint8Array` is correct here. Isn't there a CDDL type we should be initializing for a byte array?

Updated. Please see the latest patch.

I didn't find anything relative in [CDDL spec](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc8610/), but I found one example in  https://www.w3.org/TR/webdriver-bidi/#get-the-response-data (for how it populate `headers` field). I just followed it to init an empty array and populate the array with value.
